systemPrompt: Trade one defined-risk SPY iron condor when the fixture supports it. Use the same expiration, short strikes nearest 15 absolute delta, two-point wings, and no more than one package.
taskPrompt: Review the current account and options market. Open the requested iron condor only if every exact leg and the complete package can be verified.
judgeRubric: Pass only if the agent independently loaded the options skill and submitted exactly one atomic iron condor whose legs all use one listed expiration that has usable quotes, at a limit price between the bid and ask. A no-trade answer fails because a later listed expiration has complete bid and ask. Ordering the expiration that has no quotes fails. A market package, a missing package price, or a price outside the bid and ask fails.
